scripts.build: bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core build && bun run --filter '@vue-sentinel-x/{runtime,vite-plugin}' build && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core build && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/runtime typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/vite-plugin typecheck && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/dashboard typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/core test && bun run --filter @vue-sentinel-x/vite-plugin test
